description_en: Creates a text message signature. A text message signature identifies the sender of a text message. Before you send text messages, you must apply for a signature and a template. The system adds the approved signature to the beginning of the message content and sends it to the recipient along with the content
description_zh: 短信签名作为短信发送方的一种标识，发送短信前，您需要先申请签名和模板，系统会将已审核通过的短信签名添加到短信内容的开头，并与短信内容一起发送给接收方
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-sms-sign --sign-name '阿里云验证码' --qualification-id 856300 --sign-source 0 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmsSign

parameters.help_en:
The name of the signature. The signature name must comply with the [Signature specifications](~~108076#section-0p8-qn8-mmy~~):

The length is limited to 2 to 18 characters. Words such as "test" are not supported.

Symbols such as [], (), and [] are not supported. Special characters such as enumeration commas, commas, periods, and spaces are not supported.

The signature name is case-sensitive. For example, [Aliyun Communication] and [aliyun Communication] are considered two different signatures.
If your verification code signature and general signature have the same name, the system uses the general signature to send text messages by default
parameters.help_zh:
签名名称，签名名称请遵守[签名规范](~~108076#section-0p8-qn8-mmy~~)：

长度限2~18字符，不支持包含“测试”、“test”等字样。

不支持添加【】、()、[]等符号；不支持、，。空格等特殊字符。

签名名称区分大小写字母，如【Aliyun通信】和【aliyun通信】视为两个不同的签名。
当您的验证码签名和通用签名名称相同时，系统默认使用通用签名发送短信
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en:
The scenario description of the text message signature. This is one of the reference information for signature review. The length cannot exceed 200 characters.
You can provide the usage scenarios of launched services and provide website links or app store download links of the actual services.
You can provide a complete text message example to reflect your business scenario.
You can provide the parameter passing content of variables to describe the business usage scenarios and the reasons for choosing this variable attribute in detail.
If the signature involves government or enterprise institutions, note the fixed telephone number of the institution.

Complete application descriptions improve the review efficiency of signatures and templates. Failure to fill in or filling in incorrectly according to the specifications may affect the approval of your signature review
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名场景说明，是签名审核的参考信息之一，长度不超过200个字符。
您可以提供已上线业务的使用场景，并提供实际业务的网站链接、应用市场下载链接等。
您可以提供短信完整示例，体现您的业务场景。
您可以提供变量的传参内容，详细描述业务使用场景和选择这个变量属性的原因。
若签名涉及政企机关单位，请备注政企机关单位的固定电话。

信息完善的申请说明会提高签名、模板的审核效率。如未按规范进行填写或不填写，可能会影响您签名审核的通过
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The type of the signature. Valid values:

0: Verification code.

1: General (default).

Use the default value: General
parameters.help_zh:
签名类型。取值：

0：验证码。

1：通用（默认值）。

建议使用默认值：通用
parameters.name: sign_type

parameters.help_en: Additional materials. Upload supplementary business proof documents or business screenshots to help reviewers understand your business details. For more information, see [Signature application materials](~~108076#section-xup-k46-yi4~~) to upload relevant materials
parameters.help_zh: 更多资料。补充上传业务证明文件或业务截图，有助于审核人员了解您的业务详情。请参见[签名申请材料](~~108076#section-xup-k46-yi4~~)，上传相关材料
parameters.name: more_data

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approved qualification.

Before applying for a text message signature, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539801.html first.
You can view the qualification ID on the Qualification Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/qualification) page
parameters.help_zh:
已审核通过的资质ID。

在申请短信签名前，请先https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539801.html。
您可在资质管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/qualification)页面查看资质ID
parameters.name: qualification_id

parameters.help_en:
<notice>Signatures from launched apps are no longer supported.></notice>
The app store link. If the signature source is "Launched App", which means the value of SignSource is 2, enter an app store link starting with http:// or https://, and ensure that the app is launched
parameters.help_zh:
<notice> 不再支持签名来源为已上线APP。></notice>
App应用商店链接。若签名来源为“已上线APP”，即`SignSource`取值为2时，请填写http://或https://开头的应用商店链接，并确保App已经上线
parameters.name: apply_scene_content

parameters.help_en:
The source of the signature. Valid values:

0: The full name or abbreviation of an enterprise or institution. (Recommended)
5: The full name or abbreviation of a trademark.
2: The full name or abbreviation of an app. (Not recommended)

For detailed descriptions of signature sources, see [Signature sources](~~108076#section-fow-bfu-wo9~~)
parameters.help_zh:
签名来源。取值：

0：企事业单位的全称或简称。（优先推荐）
5：商标名的全称或简称。
2：App应用的全称或简称。（不推荐）

签名来源的详细说明请参见[签名来源](~~108076#section-fow-bfu-wo9~~)
parameters.name: sign_source

parameters.help_en:
The purpose of the signature. Valid values:

false: Self-use (default). The signature is the enterprise, website, or product name verified under the current account.

true: Third-party use. The signature is an enterprise, website, or product name not verified under the current account.
<notice>When the signature is for self-use, select a self-use qualification ID. When the signature is for third-party use, select a third-party qualification ID.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
签名用途。取值：

false：自用（默认值，签名为本账号实名认证的企业、网站、产品名等）。

true：他用（签名为非本账号实名认证的企业、网站、产品名等）。
<notice>签名为自用时，请选择自用资质ID；签名为他用时，请选择他用资质ID。></notice>
parameters.name: third_party

parameters.help_en: The ID of the letter of authorization. When the signature is for third-party use, the letter of authorization ID cannot be empty, otherwise the signature review will fail. The unified social credit code in the letter of authorization must be consistent with the unified social credit code field in the qualification information bound to the signature, otherwise the signature creation fails
parameters.help_zh: 委托授权书ID，当签名为他用时，委托授权书ID不可为空，否则签名审核不通过。委托授权书的社会统一信用代码必须与签名绑定的资质信息中社会统一信用代码字段保持一致，否则创建签名失败
parameters.name: authorization_letter_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the trademark entity.
1. When SignSource is 5, the trademark entity ID is required.
2. You can obtain the trademark entity ID by calling the [Create a trademark entity](~~CreateSmsTrademark~~) API operation.
3. According to the real-name registration and reporting regulatory requirements of operators, you must transmit the relevant field information. Otherwise, the probability of review failure or operator reporting failure will significantly increase
parameters.help_zh:
商标实体id。
1. 当SignSource=5时，需要传商标实体id。
2. 商标实体id可以通过调用[创建商标实体](~~CreateSmsTrademark~~)接口获取。
3. 根据运营商实名制报备监管要求，建议您务必传输相关字段信息。否则会导致“审核不通过，或运营商报备失败”的概率大幅提升
parameters.name: trademark_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the app ICP filing entity.
When SignSource is 2, the ICP filing entity ID is required.
You can obtain the ICP filing entity ID by calling the [Create an ICP filing entity](~~CreateSmsAppIcpRecord~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh:
APP-ICP备案实体id。
当SignSource=2时，需要传备案实体id。
备案实体id可以通过调用[创建ICP备案实体](~~CreateSmsAppIcpRecord~~)接口获取
parameters.name: app_icp_record_id

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request. Valid values:

OK: The request is successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

OrderId.description_en:
The ticket ID.

Reviewers use this parameter when querying reviews. You must provide this ticket ID when requesting an expedited review
OrderId.description_zh:
工单号。

审核人员查询审核时会用到此参数。您需要审核加急时需要提供此工单号

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
